_comment: Rollout/executor lockstep #16 (docs/design/rollout-executor-lockstep.md; LandfallElementals d3 s4004 gi28, 2026-10-19): a PITCH EVOKE cast inside a breakpoint continuation must replay with its exiled card. Board: Risen Reef + a 0/1 Akoum Hellhound (the attacker), one Mountain; hand Akoum Hellhound + Brushfire Elemental; Fury on top, Forests below; opponent at 2. The only T4 kill: cast the second Hellhound, Reef looks Fury into hand (site-10 breakpoint), the continuation EVOKES Fury exiling Brushfire, Fury's entry is another Reef look (a Forest, landfall: the attacker is 2/3). The search commits it either way; before the fix the breakpoint record carried no pitch_name, the replay's pitch guard declined the cast and the game realised T5.
